as_told.title: Chris Mellon's program contact dies of heart attack before meeting

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a story from Chris Mellon, a former Pentagon official who has pushed for UFO openness. According to Michels, Mellon says he nearly met someone who worked inside a secret government UFO program, sometime in the 2010s or later. In one telling, Michels adds that the meeting was all set up, and two weeks before it the man suddenly died of a heart attack. The story matters to those who tell it because it suggests insiders with first-hand knowledge are hard to reach.
